feedback.problem: What is the linear transformation $T$ whose standard matrix is $T=[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Consider a general vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}].$ Multiplying by the matrix $T,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-y \\ x+3y\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $\,T\,$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}-y \\ x+3y\end{aligned}].
$$
